| [CLAIM-406](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-406.md) v2 | Structural, pre-emptive testimonial injustice has the form of the record's trust loop: an arrangement that decides whose word is sought can keep an early exclusion going through the indicators of competence that only being sought produces, with no continuing prejudiced act; but the loop alone cannot tell perpetuated privilege from merited expertise, because that needs the prejudice condition the dynamics do not contain | The owner's, U24 of the exchange of 2026-10-20, on A23's closing thesis: "this seems to me reminiscent of themes in feminist philosophy, e.g. perpetuation of privilege". | [CLAIM-413](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-413.md) v2 | Grounding is not a property of an experience but a relation among an interpretation, what it purports to be about, and a process that constrains it independently; in its current, developmental and epistemic senses it comes apart from whether the interpretation occurs, so ungrounded is not unconstrained, and what makes an interpretive organization experiential need not be what makes its contents veridical | The owner's premise at U1, that sensory apparatus is necessary for grounded experience, as A1, A3, A5 and A7 restated it. | [CLAIM-426](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-426.md) | Where a judgement's circulation helps bring about what it says, its visibility, repetition and attributed plurality are evidence about what it will bring about, so the rule that a judgement's authority should come from its grounds and not its visibility holds for judgements of what already is, and not without qualification for judgements of what someone or something will become | The owner, on 2026-10-23, after [CLAIM-425](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-425.md) was filed: "this is reminding me of 'hyperstition'".
